3. Prefer dbp: properties when both dbo:/dbp: are available

PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?grandfather ?grandfatherName WHERE {
  dbr:Margaret_of_Bavaria,_Marchioness_of_Mantua dbp:father ?father .
  ?father dbp:father ?grandfather .
  OPTIONAL { ?grandfather rdfs:label ?grandfatherName . FILTER (lang(?grandfatherName) = "en") }
}
LIMIT 100
